create_fused_softcap: create a fused softcap operation on a tensor using a Triton kernel with configurable softcap constant
build_rmsnorm_layer: build a fused RMS normalization layer applied to a 2D tensor with learnable weight and epsilon
create_dual_residual_rmsnorm: create a dual residual RMSNorm that applies RMSNorm1, adds residual, then applies RMSNorm2 in a single kernel
summarize_experts_combine_triton: summarize the Triton kernel that combines MoE expert outputs with MLP hidden states
run_gelu_and_mul_triton: run a fused GELU-and-multiply operation on the first half of a split hidden state tensor
